slides.texte_overlay:
How to get your life back
on track in 30 days
Week one: fix your sleep. Same bedtime, same wake-up time, no phone in bed. Everything else gets easier once your body is properly rested.
Week one, too: clean your space. Your room, your car, your desktop. A clear environment makes it much easier to think clearly. Fresh start, fresh head.
Week two: move every day. A walk, a run, a short workout. You don't need a perfect plan, you need to show up for thirty minutes daily.
Week three: cut one thing that drains you. Late-night drinking, a toxic group chat, endless gaming. Removing one bad habit frees a lot of energy.
Every day for 30 days: five minutes of history, art or science. Learning something new each morning reminds you that you're growing again.
slides.texte_sophia: Every day for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Learning something new each morning reminds you that you're growing again.

slides.texte_overlay: Week four: reconnect with people. Call your parents, message an old friend, plan a dinner. Getting back on track is easier with people around you.
Day thirty: write down what changed. Seeing your progress on paper is what makes you keep going for the next thirty days and beyond.
